test_title: PYST 39: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The letter was written by the author and mailed to the publisher.

options.text: The letter was written and mailed to the publisher by the author.
The author wrote the letter and mailed it to the publisher.
The publisher received the letter written by the author.
The letter was being written by the author and mailed to the publisher.

solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 2' i.e. The author wrote the letter and mailed it to the publisher is the correct transformation into active voice.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• The original sentence is in passive voice, indicating that the action was performed by the author.

• Active voice requires the subject to perform the action, which is "The author" in this case.

• Option 2 correctly changes the sentence to active voice by stating the subject first followed by the verb and the object.

• This option maintains the original meaning of the sentence without altering the sequence of actions performed by the author.

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Correct sentence: *The author wrote the letter and mailed it to the publisher*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Option 1 is incorrect because it still presents the sentence in passive voice, which doesn't fulfill the requirement of transforming the sentence into active voice.

• Option 3 changes the focus of the sentence to the publisher receiving the letter, which alters the original meaning.

• Option 4 introduces a continuous tense ("was being written") which is not present in the original sentence, thus changing the meaning unnecessarily.
